items.title: File Widerspruch against refusal of hunting licence
items.quote: Binnen eines Monats ab der Bekanntgabe dieses Bescheids ist der Widerspruch zulässig; er wird schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei folgender Stelle erhoben: Kreis Musterdithmarschen, Stiftstraße 8, 25746 Musterheide in Holstein.
items.computation: Bescheiddatum (date of issue) = 19.11.2026 (Thursday), sent by simple letter. Per the letter's own cited rule (§ 110 Abs. 2 LVwG), a letter sent by simple post counts as delivered (bekannt gegeben) on the 4th day after posting. Assuming posting on the day of issue (19.11.2026, day 0): day 1 = 20.11 (Fri), day 2 = 21.11 (Sat), day 3 = 22.11 (Sun), day 4 = 23.11.2026 (Monday). 23.11.2026 is a normal working day in Schleswig-Holstein, so no weekend/holiday shift applies to the fictive delivery date itself; Bekanntgabe = 23.11.2026. The one-month Widerspruchsfrist then runs under §§ 187 Abs. 1, 188 Abs. 2 BGB: the day of the event (23.11.) is excluded, the period starts 24.11.2026 and a 'month' period ends on the day of the following month bearing the same calendar number as the triggering day, i.e. 23.12.2026. 23.12.2026 is a Wednesday and not a public holiday in Schleswig-Holstein, so no further shift is needed. Final day for the Widerspruch to reach the authority: 23.12.2026.

items.title: Submit a valid proof of hunting liability insurance to obtain the licence
items.quote: Sobald Sie eine gültige Versicherungsbestätigung nachreichen, stelle ich den Jagdschein ohne neuen Antrag aus.
items.computation: The letter invites the recipient to submit a current, valid Jagdhaftpflichtversicherungs-Nachweis at any time (the previous proof expired on 30.06.2026) to have the licence issued without filing a new application. No specific calendar date or period is given for this submission, so no fixed due date can be derived from the text.

warnings: The deemed delivery date (23.11.2026) and thus the Widerspruch deadline (23.12.2026) assume the letter was actually posted on its printed issue date (19.11.2026); if postage occurred later, the deadline shifts accordingly and the person should check the envelope postmark if available.

No deadline is given in the letter for resubmitting a valid insurance confirmation; the hunting licence application will remain unresolved until this is provided, but there is no statutory time limit stated.
